integrity: Exhaustive feedback-table and Euler-tour enumerations, direct interval dynamic programming and an independent center-expansion shortest-path method. Standalone Python 3 and C++17 programs were run to VERIFY_OK.
scientific_limitations: All exact distributions and extremal representatives are restricted to binary de Bruijn cycles of order five and their 32 linear roots; no higher-order formula or external certification is asserted.
title: Cyclic palindromic factorization spectrum of binary order-five de Bruijn cycles
